about: S6 城內 (the inner city): who speaks and what (the life pass, gen/life/progress.md; format tools/talk_data.mjs; lines from gen/life/vignettes_S4_S6.md V6.1-V6.15 and the readings: 名画记 36-47, 余辉 2015/2021/2023, 东京梦华录). scenes: near talks (press E at the host; `as` = the line for who you play, `again` = the next talk with the same host). chatter: groups that talk among themselves when you are within earshot. barks: a lone figure's word now and then (`close`: a call to you as you come near). Every role is a painted figure of people.json; every line cites its reading (src); 繁體, no numbers on screen; lines fit the figure's clips. Plot-line steps told here: grain.5 (c6.sackcart), wine.3 (V6.7, c6.wagons), wine.4 (V6.4, c6.upstairs), qingming.4 (V6.12, c6.paper), screen.3 (V6.16, c6.scholars). Bundled by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/talk.json.
